hypothesis: Removing only the default æ+ŋ exclusion restores the supported rime family during initial root generation. No vowel, coda, cluster, spelling weight or gate threshold is changed.
cohort: The original and candidate 200,000-word development archives, four profiles and five replicates each. No validation outputs are read.

layers.generatedBase: generateSyllables.after from the selected attempt; includes boundary adjustments inside that stage, excludes later stress repair. This is not a log of all rejected proposals.
layers.preparedBase: generateWrittenForm.before, after root structure and stress repair but before surface realization and morphology in these two source revisions.
layers.output: Final word.syllables after surface realization and morphology; output coordinates are not assumed to be root coordinates.

primary: Generation-stage æ+ŋ syllables and paired words, with counts of all syllables, æ nuclei, closed æ syllables and ŋ codas. These are selected-output denominators, not unrecorded planned-coda opportunities or an optimal frequency target.
categories: A pair means æ anywhere in the nucleus and ŋ anywhere in the same coda, matching the existing configuration's any-segment exclusion. An exact pair has nucleus [æ] and coda [ŋ]; an extended pair has at least two coda segments. Multi-segment nuclei, if observed, are counted explicitly rather than normalized to one vowel.
strata: Profile, replicate, actual morphology template, output syllable count, and layer-relative position only/initial/medial/final. Historical stage snapshots omit stress, so their stress stratum is unavailable. Final surface stress is primary, secondary, unmarked or other; unmarked is not asserted to be unstressed.
transitions: Position-aligned generation→prepared and stress-repair before→after pairs are retained, introduced or removed only when both arrays have equal positive length. Missing or incomparable evidence is unavailable. No root→surface lineage is inferred through morphology.
witnesses: Retain the first complete selected draw per profile for generated/prepared pairs, their extended codas, and pairs introduced by stress repair. Witnesses are illustrations; complete counters measure all archived draws.
acceptance: Public-API deterministic fixtures establish exact/extended/nonfinal default coverage and retained custom/rhotic exclusions at coda selection. Candidate profiles must report initial coverage, while later emergent pairs remain separate. Trace on/off complete outputs and RNG remain identical. Archive checks and an independent Python counter must agree. All frozen-core metrics, n-gram gates and performance changes are disclosed; no human preference gain is inferred.

reference.interpretation: Pinned word-type observations support availability, not target frequencies or universal bans. Names, loans, inflections and compounds remain in the reference; its syllabifier is not a phonotactic oracle.
